name: Screen-Space Ambient Occlusion (SSAO)
definition: A post-processing technique that estimates ambient occlusion by sampling points in a hemisphere around each pixel's surface position and checking if those points are occluded by geometry in the depth buffer.
summary: SSAO is a fast post-processing technique that estimates ambient occlusion using 2D screen-space depth and normal buffers, distinguishing itself by avoiding full 3D geometry queries.
